description: Illustrative UART-Lite register map for the Document C §C.4 worked example. Schema: tools/register_map_schema.json. Not derived from any specific commercial silicon.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register. Firmware writes both bits; peripheral observes them.

fields.name: tx_start
fields.description: Rising edge starts a transmit of the byte currently in DATA.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Master enable. Clearing this pauses both TX and RX.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status register. Peripheral writes; firmware reads. Concurrent reads from firmware are safe.

fields.name: tx_busy
fields.description: High while a transmit is in flight. Firmware polls this before writing DATA.

fields.name: rx_ready
fields.description: High when a received byte is available in DATA.

registers.name: DATA
registers.description: Data register. On writes, the low 8 bits become the next TX byte. On reads, the low 8 bits return the latest received byte and rx_ready is cleared as a side-effect.
